stem:
A bus looks still to Aditi sitting in it, but moving to Kabir on the road.

Is the bus in motion?

options.text: It cannot be both; motion does not depend on a reference.
It is at rest relative to Aditi and in motion relative to Kabir.
It is moving only if the driver says so.
Rest and motion are the same for every observer.

teacher.key_rationale: Motion or rest is judged against a chosen reference. Different references can disagree honestly.
